# Velza Global Group

> Velza Global Group develops, manufactures, imports and distributes premium
> beverage, FMCG and lifestyle brands across Hong Kong, India and the
> Philippines through strategic partnerships.

Velza Global Group is a brand development and distribution company operating in
three markets: Hong Kong, India and the Philippines. Its portfolio spans
caffeinated and energy beverages, Italian spirits, coffee, lifestyle
accessories, and the Rosso Caffè café concept. Its best-known partnership is
with Tonino Lamborghini, whose caffeinated beverages Velza manufactures and
distributes in India and launched exclusively in the Philippines.

Note on regional serving: every URL below is a single canonical address. The
site detects the visitor's country at the edge and serves a Hong Kong, India or
Philippines variant of the same page from an internal path. There are no
separate per-country URLs to crawl, and the regional source directories are not
directly reachable.

## Company

- [Velza Global Group | Premium FMCG, Beverages & Lifestyle](https://www.velzaglobal.com/): Home page. How Velza Global builds premium beverage, FMCG and lifestyle brands across its three markets through strategic partnerships.
- [About Velza Global Group](https://www.velzaglobal.com/about-us): How Velza Global develops, manufactures, imports and distributes premium consumer brands across Hong Kong, India and the Philippines.
- [Contact Velza Global Group](https://www.velzaglobal.com/contact-us): Contact details and enquiry form for distribution, strategic partnerships, hospitality opportunities and general business enquiries.

## Brands and portfolio

- [Premium Brand Portfolio](https://www.velzaglobal.com/portfolio): Overview of the full portfolio — luxury beverages, Italian spirits, coffee, lifestyle essentials and Rosso Caffè.
- [Tonino Lamborghini Caffeinated Beverages](https://www.velzaglobal.com/luxury-beverage): The Tonino Lamborghini caffeinated beverage range presented by Velza Global, including Original and zero-sugar variants.
- [Premium Italian Spirits Collection](https://www.velzaglobal.com/pure-italian-spirits): Vodka, gin, whisky and tequila, positioned around heritage, quality and refined serving rituals.
- [Premium Italian Coffee Collection](https://www.velzaglobal.com/coffee-collection): Italian-inspired coffee blends — Black, Red, Platinum, decaffeinated and filter.
- [Premium Lifestyle Essentials](https://www.velzaglobal.com/lifestyle-essentials): Watches, eyewear, leather goods and accessories curated around Italian design and craftsmanship.
- [Rosso Caffè](https://www.velzaglobal.com/rosso-caffe): An Italian-inspired café concept built around premium coffee, artisanal food and hospitality.

- [Velza Global News](https://www.velzaglobal.com/news): Index of announcements, strategic partnerships, product launches and milestones.

- [Velza Global & Tonino Lamborghini Partnership in India](https://www.velzaglobal.com/velza-global-tonino-lamborghini-partnership-india): Strategic partnership to manufacture and distribute Tonino Lamborghini Caffeinated Beverages in India.
